item: a Stop during a live mailbox pull ends it and keeps what was fetched
summary: The IMAP and POP3 pulls read the kill switch again before every command and every message; on a Stop no further command is sent, the connection the pull opened is closed without LOGOUT/QUIT, and the messages fetched before it are kept, marked stopped_by_airplane_mode in the job result and the Settings answer (x12). Release line: if you turn on airplane mode while the app is pulling newsletters from your mailbox, the pull now stops at once, sends nothing more to the mail server, and keeps the messages it had already fetched.
